Creator Picking SOP

Built Wed 4 Nov, 8:55pm · from Arvin's calls on 100 creators, updated with his 9 corrections on 4 Nov 2026

Your job: look at TikTok Shop creators and pick the ones worth emailing about our creator program. Each creator we pick gets a free kit of lashes, which costs us money and stock, so we only want women who will actually film good beauty videos for us. Everyone on your list already makes money on TikTok Shop and posts a lot. Your job is to judge what her videos look like.

1. The four checks

Tick a creator only if all four are true. Look at her 5 thumbnails, and click one to watch it if you're not sure. Look closely: lashes and small products are easy to miss.

  1. It's her. The same woman, her own face, in most of the videos. Close to the camera is good, but a clear beauty product in her hands matters more than how close she is.
  2. She's a beauty woman. At least 3 of the 5 videos are beauty: makeup, eye makeup, lashes, lash serum, skincare or fragrance. That means holding a product up, putting it on, or a green screen over a beauty video. 2 is enough if those 2 are high-quality beauty videos. Her other videos can be anything.
  3. Her videos look like beauty videos. Good lighting, a ring light or vanity-style setup, her face close, makeup on, hair done. If she's filmed like a beauty creator, she can make our videos, even when this week's video is about something else.
  4. Real variety. At least 4 different videos. If the thumbnails are the same video over and over, it's a no.

The biggest yes signs

If you see thisLean
She's holding false lashesStrongest yes. She's a false-lash creator
She's wearing false lashesStrong yes. She's already our kind of customer
Eye makeup, lash serum or anything around her eyes, even if it looks like skincare at firstYes, it counts as beauty
Mostly skincareFine. Skincare creators are open to beauty products too

6. How to do it each day

  1. Open the review page Arvin sends you.
  2. For each creator, run the four checks. Tick ✓ if all four pass, cross ✕ if not.
  3. Not sure? Leave her blank and write her number down with one line on why you're unsure. Arvin decides those, and his answer gets added to this page.
  4. When you finish the page, hit Copy verdicts and send the code to Arvin with your list of unsure ones.

Nothing sends from the review page. Nobody gets emailed until Arvin passes your code on.

7. Your first week: practice round

Arvin has already judged every creator on the practice page. Do it blind using this SOP, then send your code. We'll compare your calls with his, and every creator you get differently from him gets added to this page as a new example. Once you match him on about 9 in 10, you run it yourself and he only spot-checks.
